title: The waiting room is the hardest place to be. 🕰️ It feels slow, frustrating, sometimes even hopeless. But the master plan is always bigger than our schedule. The delay isn't a denial; it's preparation for perfection. Just wait for the reveal. 🙏✨
paragraphs: The waiting room is the hardest place to be. 🕰️ It feels slow, frustrating, sometimes even hopeless. But the master plan is always bigger than our schedule. The delay isn't a denial; it's preparation for perfection. Just wait for the reveal. 🙏✨
